evidence: Full *garda article documents cushions, pads, seats and a stuffed seat gadelā, but not the palm or gadauri/gadeli hand terms. Existing Bundeli and Dang survey links to this parent are discovery aids, not independent primary etymological proof.

Full padma article documents lotus, Prakrit padama/pōma and botanical uses, but no hand-palm sense. The resemblance of pədəm/podom palm could motivate a lotus metaphor, but that semantic link needs regional primary evidence.
